finding: The selected007 short-core witness retained nonnegative sediment and exact saved continuation while closing its modeled mass and beam accounts to floating-point residuals.
limitations: Transport velocities, erosion thresholds and optical partitions are authored; not calibrated sediment hydrodynamics.
Scattered-out light leaves the resolved direct beam; its subsequent path and conversion to heat are not modeled.
The short witness has no intervention, long-run,3D or general stability guarantee.
Source replay checks are not physical validation, and no scientific code was executed in this publication pipeline.
method: Donor-limited finite-volume-like transfers between suspended/deposited stores, followed by a five-band Beer-Lambert direct-beam calculation.
open_questions: How do transport and optical outcomes change under independently justified parameters and refinement?
